prior_work: freight_horizon forecasts ten-step deposited principal (not next command). freight_response covered 16 episodes/6 previous maps; two full-response experiments examined broad three-step multi-exit coverage. interception_layer also uses previous data. New task immediately occupy an enemy shortest return exit while its carrier is >=3 hops from home; four new maps, all source turns, sober per-root cargo transfers and no selection from development loss peaks.
public_population: Each visible enemy collector cargo >=100, nearest own base distance >=3, and has reduced its nearest-base distance from t-3 to t. Every real turn, both physical seats; keep all eligible carriers even with no available blocker when fitting. Never look at map seed, opposing simultaneous commands, unseen carbon or future observations when designing candidates.
forecast: Fit one shared conditional softmax over physical [NONE,UP,RIGHT,DOWN,LEFT] from all eligible carriers on training maps only. Action-relative distance-to-home change, previous direction, distances to collectors/planters, support and congestion, publicly known trees/bases, our frozen original friendly destinations; no future/opposing action input. Map-equal likelihood, L2=.02, zero init, 100 gradient descent steps, learning rate .7. No checkpoint or threshold selection. Enemy command only labels training/validation.
v1_and_alternative: Each real v1 collector may directly occupy one shortest NEXT exit from the enemy collector now, including staying there, and its collision cargo after its chosen action must be strictly less than the enemy cargo after moving. Exclude current original order if identical and avoid all other friendly commanded destinations/approved new recruits. Rank by expected extra ownership: (probability enemy lands at candidate cell minus probability it lands at incumbent landing cell)*enemy post-move cargo. Maximize per physical turn, tiebreak hostile UID, own UID, physical move index. Issue only positive predicted advantage. All unchanged original joint commands stay in both arms. Reference rule is uniform on shortest exits with identical candidate enumeration/tie/threshold. If inferred future cell or movement fails report zero/negative. Predict all five actions, including none.
outcome: Primary signed full-side cross-team collision cargo transfer: hostile to our winning worker/tree/base minus reverse. Compare against v1. Focal and all-crew movements separated; winner backpack, direct tree/base cash, newly dropped cargo and cap burn, opportunity own collection/deposit/spending/death and all cash separately. Label true turn using both simultaneous orders and official Board + FastCarbon all-stock agreement. Report number of open enemy exits among shortest and among all five after each friendly order; public geometry conditional on only our committed interventions. No claim about next enemy strategy response or ultimate gain.
evaluation: Full source terminal identities and all factual source steps must match along with every tested candidate fork. Per-source-turn map-equal gain includes all nonintervention turns as zeros; separate issued positives/zeros/negatives, comparisons on identical feasible opportunity sets, grouped by physical seat/map and facts with truly credited measured gains.
future: Select at most one issued plus one actionable-unissued validation root per physical map/seat by fixed SHA sort over root identity, no outcome labels. List all empty strata and complete source path/worker/position and pre-3/5/10 evidence for sparse response runs. No new matches and no independent formal claim.
